title: tasks released by an event run after it is set
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events (partial order).

stdout.justification: Cooperative scheduling order between independently runnable tasks is not specified; only the causal order enforced by the program (event, channel, await) is asserted.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: async/event: wait() suspends until set(); set() releases every waiter; repeated set() is harmless. Both releases follow `setting` and precede the awaited sum; their mutual order is unspecified.
